The '''Mission to Had Abbadon''' was a skirmish that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Had Abbadon]], a mythical world located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

==The battle==
As part of their plot to assassinate [[Darth Krayt]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], the strikeforce composed by [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]], former [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] and [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Antares Draco]], [[Ganner Krieg]], and [[Azlyn Rae]], with the support of [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], attacked an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] garrison located on Had Abbadon. Their purpose was to draw Emperor Krayt away from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to eliminate him. At this time, a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Reave]] sensed the presence of Jedi on the planet.

While Masters Draco and Krieg attacked the garrison aboard two [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]], Morne, Skywalker and Rae faced numbers of Reave's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. In order to turn the battle for their side, Morne, under the influence of [[Karness Muur]], used the [[Muur Talisman]] to turn all nearby stormtroopers and Imperial officers into [[rakghoul]]s. The monsters turned against their former commander, causing him to escape. Morne used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent Cade and Rae from stopping Reave, giving him a chance to return to his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]].<ref name="leg29" /><ref name="SWL30" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Was it Skywalker who inflicted these wounds?''"<br />"''Not Skywalker, Lord Krayt. A ''Jedi woman'' with him&hellip;turned our troopers into monsters&hellip;they attacked me&hellip;|Darth Reave, reporting to Emperor Krayt|<ref name="SWL30" />}}
Bleeding profusely from his bites and wounds, Reave reported to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt of his failure. He did make Krayt aware that it was Skywalker who battled him in the Deep Core and that another unfamiliar Jedi was present&mdash;one who used the dark side to create monsters out of Reave's stormtroopers. Before he could complete his report, Reave himself began to transform into one of the very creatures he encountered on Had Abbadon. When the change was complete, the Devaronian Sith was no more; instead he was mindless [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]], and he charged forward to attack the Emperor. He never reached his target, as he was intercepted by Krayt's [[Hand (One Sith)|Hand]], [[Darth Stryfe]], who proceeded to [[Sai cha/Legends|behead]] the creature. Lord Krayt then ordered his [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], [[Darth Maladi]], to examine the corpse, and she immediately discovered that he had been transformed into a product of ancient [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], a rakghoul, after having been infected with the creature's plague.<ref name="SWL30" />
